messages:
Kai (customer): Hey support — our per-model throughput curves in Console for tenant `pro-aurora` went to 0 around 2026-03-10 12:05 UTC. API still serving requests (no 5xx), but Console panels show flat zeros. Ticket C-7892 and screenshot: https://s3.redwood/prod-screenshots/ppo/shot123.png

Maya (support): On it. Can you paste example model id and region? Any recent metric/exporter changes?

Kai (customer): model id `rwd-llama-13b-v1`, region `us-west-2`. We rotated exporter labels last night as part of a cleanup: renamed label `model` -> `model_name`. Thought dashboards would continue to work. Prometheus scrape shows metrics with `model_name`, not `model`.

Maya (support): Thanks — escalating to eng-platform. @Liam can you take a look?

deploy-bot: Escalation created: ENG-1259 (auto) — priority P2 — assignee: liam

Liam (eng-platform): Looking now. Can you paste the relabel snippet you used and a grafana/prometheus query from the Console panel?

Kai (customer): relabel snippet we applied in exporter sidecar:```yaml
relabel_configs:
  - source_labels: ["__meta_kubernetes_pod_label_model"]
    target_label: "model_name"
    action: replace
```
Grafana panel query (from Console):```promql
sum by (model) (redwood_inference_requests_total{tenant="pro-aurora"})
```

Liam (eng-platform): That explains it — dashboard is aggregating by `model` label. We used a compatibility relabeling for earlier rollout but it only applied to a subset of scrape targets. Looks like this target missed it, so Prom still doesn't expose `model` label for those metrics.

Sophia (eng-runtime): Quick workaround you can try: update Prometheus config to synthesize `model` from `model_name` using relabel, e.g.```yaml
- source_labels: ["model_name"]
  target_label: "model"
  regex: "(.+)"
  replacement: "$1"
  action: replace
```
Or use a grafana-side fix with label_replace in queries:```promql
sum by (model) (label_replace(redwood_inference_requests_total, "model", "$1", "model_name", "(.+)") )
```

Anya (eng-sre): Mitigation steps I'd recommend: 1) Add the relabel_config to your Prom scrape job and `/-/reload` prometheus, 2) if you're on Hosted Prom we can push a short-term relabel rule in the scrape layer to backfill `model` for the tenant.

Liam (eng-platform): I'll also open a Console patch to make dashboard queries tolerant: prefer `model_name` if present, fallback to `model`. That avoids cross-tenant breakage on label migrations. I'll link PR here once ready.

Maya (support): Kai, can you try the prometheus relabel + reload and then let us know? If you can't reload, we can restart the exporter sidecar or restart the scrape target.

Kai (customer): I reloaded Prometheus config and restarted the sidecar: `kubectl -n monitoring rollout restart deployment/prometheus-main`. Prom shows metrics with both `model_name` and `model` now (verified with `promql: topk(5, redwood_inference_requests_total{tenant="pro-aurora"})`). Panels still blank though — maybe Console caches metric label schemas.

Anya (eng-sre): Cleared Console metrics schema cache for tenant `pro-aurora` via Admin -> Metrics -> Purge cache. Also triggered a dashboard cache refresh.

Kai (customer): Graphs came back ~90s after purge. Throughput lines restored. Thanks everyone! :thumbsup:

Maya (support): Great — marking the ticket as resolved, will re-open if it recurs. @Liam please follow up with dashboard fallback PR and a runbook for label migrations.

Liam (eng-platform): Will do. Opening ENG-1260 for the dashboard fix and runbook.

Maya (support): Closing this thread, leaving notes in the ticket about the exporter label rename and the required Prom relabel and cache purge steps. :party_parrot:
